attribute_fields.COMMENTS: West Virginia state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 5 brackets per WV Tax Division (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "West Virginia Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.wv_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate WV tax using progressive brackets (same for all filing statuses)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.wv_personal_exemption sub 0 max dup /wv_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /wv_tax xdef
wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_1_limit min result.wv_bracket_1_rate mul /wv_tax xdef
wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_1_limit gt { wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_2_limit min result.wv_bracket_1_limit sub result.wv_bracket_2_rate mul wv_tax add /wv_tax xdef } if
wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_2_limit gt { wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_3_limit min result.wv_bracket_2_limit sub result.wv_bracket_3_rate mul wv_tax add /wv_tax xdef } if
wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_3_limit gt { wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_4_limit min result.wv_bracket_3_limit sub result.wv_bracket_4_rate mul wv_tax add /wv_tax xdef } if
wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_4_limit gt { wv_taxable_income result.wv_bracket_4_limit sub result.wv_bracket_5_rate mul wv_tax add /wv_tax xdef } if
wv_tax /result.wv_state_tax xdef wv_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"West Virginia tax calculated: $" result.wv_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
